limitations: Definition checking uses the requested union across selectors, metadata defaults, fixture values and reassembled host declarations; selector reachability and runtime invalid-value/cycle semantics are not established by this static audit.
Undefined references with a fallback are reported separately and are not render-breaking solely due to absence. Official-color-list violations remain contract violations even if a fallback renders.
Input file SHA256 records fix the exact inspected snapshot; concurrent subsequent author changes require rechecking those changed files.
The current task verifies visual-audit metadata and PNG hashes; it does not replace actual human visual inspection or approve missing/stale visual verdicts.
Source freeze is reported as observed hash consistency. Author work may still be active, and no mutation is interpreted as authorization or permanent freeze.
